text:
Predicates:
OlympicEvent(x) ::: x is a summer Olympic game.
LastEvent(x) ::: x is the last summer Olympic game.
InLocation(x, y) ::: x was held in location y.
UnitedStates(x) ::: x is the United States.
WonMostMedals(x, y) ::: x won the most medals at event y.
Premises:
OlympicEvent(lastEvent) ∧ InLocation(lastEvent, tokyo) ::: The last summer Olympic games was in Tokyo.
WonMostMedals(UnitedStates, lastEvent) ::: The United States won the most medals in Tokyo.
Conclusion:
¬InLocation(lastEvent, tokyo) ::: The last summer Olympic games were not in Tokyo.
